projects.name: flow
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: markdown skills, agents, shell hooks
projects.gateCommand: find . -name '*.json' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 jq empty && find . -name '*.test.sh' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r -n1 bash

projects.name: watch
projects.description: Go binary + Claude Code plugin: coding-agent session monitoring (tmux, waybar, noctalia, DMS)

projects.name: sandbox
projects.description: Docker/Podman container for isolated Claude Code sessions
projects.gateCommand: n=0; for t in tests/*.test.sh; do [ "$t" = tests/smoke.test.sh ] && continue; bash "$t" || exit 1; n=$((n+1)); done; [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || exit 1
